Help Vsauce and I release the world’s first smart Cloud Chamber here: https://inqfactory.com/kyle

What is a cloud chamber, and how can you use one to see radiation? Invented by physicist C. T. R. Wilson in 1911, the cloud chamber is a Nobel Prize-winning scientific instrument that makes invisible charged particles visible through trails of tiny droplets. I teamed up with Michael Stevens of Vsauce to develop a modern smart cloud chamber that makes this incredible particle physics experiment accessible at home to everyone and after more than a year of development, we're bringing a 100-year-old scientific demonstration into the modern age. We present to you: the world’s first plug-and-play cloud chamber.
